title: ToolService.list
description: Lists the tools in ID order, each with its status from its active loan and condition (`entry`).

title: measureOutcomes
description: Answered by running `src/outcomes.ts` from the command line with the month as its argument: it opens the SQLite store named by `DB`, checks `TIME_ZONE` (New York by default), prints what `measureOutcomes` works out as JSON and closes the store. Nothing is kept between runs.
